lines.text: Many learners say: I am agree with you.

native.tip: agree는 동사라 am이 필요 없어요. “I agree with you”예요.
native.caption: “I am agree with you”라고 말하고 있나요? 😅 agree 자체가 동사라서 be 동사 am을 붙이지 않아요. “I agree with you”가 맞아요. Carlos 선생님을 따라 말해 보세요! Lexkite 앱에서 더 연습해요.
native.comment: 정답: “agree”. am 빼고 I agree! 무료 퀴즈로 더 연습해 보세요: {link}

en.tip: Agree is a verb already. No am. Say “I agree with you”.
en.caption: Do you say “I am agree with you”? 😅 Agree is already a verb, so you do not add “am”. “I agree with you” is right. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
